parameters.name: AlibabaSideAsn
parameters.description: The autonomous system number (ASN) of the ECR instance. Valid values: 45104 (default), 64512 to 65534, and 4200000000 to 4294967294. The ASN 65025 is reserved for use by Alibaba Cloud.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a value from your client and make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The \`ClientToken\` parameter supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each request.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the ECR instance.

> The description can be empty or 0 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: sends a check request without modifying service resources.

- **false** (default): sends a normal request.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the ECR instance.

> The name can be empty or 0 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the ECR instance belongs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description:
The tags.

You can add up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. The key cannot be an empty string. The key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. The value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, cannot start with `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
